boardName: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board
verifiedBy: SOURCED — taken directly from CMWSSB's own official tariff pages (cmwssb.tn.gov.in/tariff and /general-tariff), which independently converge on identical slab rates (₹8/₹20/₹32/₹51 per KL) and a 25% sewerage charge. Unlike DJB, CMWSSB does not tier its fixed/minimum charge by meter size — it publishes one flat minimum-monthly-charge per dwelling unit (the two official pages show ₹100 and ₹111 respectively; the higher, more specifically-dated figure is used here). That minimum is described officially as already including sewerage for near-zero consumption, so this model — which adds the 25% sewerage charge on top of the fixed charge for every consumption level, same as every other board here — may slightly overstate very-low-usage CMWSSB bills. CMWSSB is also mid-rollout on smart metering, so unmetered domestic connections may still be billed differently in practice.
